title: Retain pre-fact staging boundary after record-container streaming audit

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit binding_records and edge_records in the canonical compile_relation_blocks owner for a deletion- or streaming-oriented bounded-memory improvement. Preserve exact cross-plane binding admission, retained relation checks, hyperedge/undirected refusal, endpoint-completeness precedence, Evidence-DAG alternatives, scalar observer semantics, discover-all completeness-before-materialization and receipt counts. Do not create an explicit-mode compiler, second classifier, cache, index, fact store or public API.

audit.current_phase_boundary: The compiler validates the Forest/Fourfold partition and selected signatures, refuses conflicting retained hyperedges, stages included verified bindings and admissible same-plane edges, validates every Forest edge including exact cross-plane binding admission and directionality, derives discover-all selected signatures, and requires complete endpoints before any _record_fact call. Only after those refusal/admission phases finish are edge_records and then binding_records reduced into bounded per-signature fact maps.
audit.direct_streaming_finding: Calling _record_fact while iterating bindings or Forest edges would move MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES refusal and evidence materialization ahead of later edge admission/refusal and, for discover-all, ahead of endpoint-completeness validation. That changes observable refusal/error precedence and can perform provenance work for a compilation that the current owner rejects before fact materialization.
audit.binding_container_finding: binding_records could be removed only by scanning snapshot.bindings again after edge validation/completeness and reconstructing RelationSignature plus endpoint indices. The immutable snapshot makes that technically possible, but it duplicates the selected-binding classifier/filter or requires extracting a new shared binding-classification helper. The first option adds a second classification path that can drift from included_binding_keys/discovery; the second adds an abstraction solely to delete one bounded list.
audit.edge_container_finding: edge_records could likewise be removed only by a second Forest-edge traversal that replays same-plane requested-signature pruning, retained-digest admission, directionality handling and endpoint-index derivation, or by introducing a shared edge-classification abstraction. Replaying the logic creates parallel admission code; extracting it expands the owner surface and would need to encode cross-plane refusal behavior that the current staging loop already owns.
audit.record_order_semantics: The current reduction order is same-plane edge facts first and verified-binding facts second. Those sources occupy disjoint same-plane versus cross-plane signatures, but preserving the order keeps existing fact-limit/error behavior stable and avoids creating a new merged fact-record union with origin tags.
audit.boundedness_context: The expensive semantic payload remains bounded per selected relation by MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES and compiled relation count by MAX_COMPILED_RELATIONS. The staging lists retain references plus already-derived signatures/indices; they are transient and disappear before the immutable CompiledRelationBlocks receipt is returned. This packet does not claim the source Forest or Fourfold collections are globally size-bounded by these constants.
audit.gardener_conclusion: Do not trade one visible staging boundary for duplicated admission logic or a new classifier/helper subsystem. Retain both record containers until a future change can delete them together with an already-required single classification pass or supplies measured evidence that their transient reference overhead is a real bottleneck.

decision.summary: Keep binding_records and edge_records as the single explicit admission-to-materialization phase boundary. Direct streaming changes refusal/materialization precedence; rescan-based deletion duplicates classification; helper-based deletion adds an abstraction without measured justification.

semantic_invariants.cross_plane_admission: A cross-plane ForestEdge still requires the exact included verified Fourfold binding key before any relation fact is materialized.
semantic_invariants.same_plane_retention: Same-plane Forest edges remain eligible only when their exact canonical digest is retained by the declared Fourfold plane.
semantic_invariants.lossy_relation_refusal: Retained hyperedges and conflicting undirected Forest edges remain refused before fact materialization.
semantic_invariants.endpoint_completeness: Explicit selected endpoints remain checked before staging; discover-all selected endpoints remain checked after discovery and before _record_fact.
semantic_invariants.observer_semantics: Boolean remains True per deduplicated semantic coordinate, natural remains unit 1, and evidence-dag retains canonical alternative witness bundles.
semantic_invariants.receipt_counts: forest_edge_count, forest_hyperedge_count and verified_binding_count remain source counts; semantic_fact_count remains the sum of compiled block entry counts.
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest and FourfoldSnapshot remain authoritative; relation blocks remain a regenerable internal computational view.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API, compatibility facade, wire schema, benchmark schema, authority or promotion contract changes.

result.summary: The audit rejected direct streaming because it would move fact-limit/provenance work ahead of later refusal and discover-all completeness checks. Removing either transient list via a second immutable-source traversal is possible but would duplicate binding/edge classification or require a new abstraction, so the existing single staging boundary is retained as the smaller design.

verification.focused_static_audit: Reviewed the exact base-head compiler phase order, canonical immutable Fourfold binding contract and selected-pruning contracts. The current tests explicitly pin signature validation and endpoint completeness before evidence materialization, exact-binding refusal before facts when binding inclusion is disabled, selected pruning, discover-all relation discovery and retained-hyperedge refusal.
verification.ci_requirement: This documentation-only closure commit still requires exact-head workflow evidence before any green-PR statement. No pre-closure workflow is inherited as closure evidence.
